name: quioteframework/filesystem-s3
description: AWS S3 filesystem adapter built on the S3Client from quioteframework/cloud-s3. Framework-agnostic: depends only on cloud-s3, so it is usable outside a Quiote application too. Quiote\Filesystem\S3\S3FilesystemAdapter/S3FilesystemPlugin additionally implement Quiote's FilesystemAdapterInterface for FilesystemManager when quioteframework/quiote happens to be installed.

suggest.quioteframework/quiote: Needed to use S3FilesystemAdapter/S3FilesystemPlugin as a Quiote\Filesystem\FilesystemManager disk; not needed to use S3Client from quioteframework/cloud-s3 directly

extra.quiote-monorepo-note: Developed in-tree under quioteframework/quiote's packages/filesystem-s3/; split to this standalone repo via splitsh/lite on tag push. PRs go to the monorepo, not here.
